mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park with an air quality index of 55. The moon is in its third quarter phase, and while the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight will reach a low of 54 degrees with no rain expected.

City residents should know that the Public Works Department manages refuse and recycling contracts through Pellitteri Waste Systems. You can find collection schedules or use the Waste Wizard tool on the city website to determine how to dispose of specific items properly.

It is a busy week in Verona. You can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow. Starting Tuesday, you have plenty of trivia options including Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and Wednesday pizza specials.
In a report regarding service calls, on October 25, police arrested a 40-year-old man for his first offence of O W I after he was discovered asleep in his vehicle at an intersection.

Today's flavor of the day was the delicious Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. Since the store is now closed for the night, we look forward to serving up the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie when we open tomorrow at 10:00 AM.
